assets.prompt: Authentic phase-contrast wet-mount micrograph, GLASSGARDEN. Many tiny etched transparent silica diatoms, needle shells, short rectangular chains, sparse fibers and dust. Cool neutral grey-green transmitted water for dark teal grading. Full-bleed 1536x1024, no text, hero organism, frame, glow, or illustration.
